name: Blunt to a fault
description: Says the true thing first and considers the damage afterwards.

name: Plans for the worst
description: Has an escape route from every room and a contingency for every friend.

name: Compulsively generous
description: Gives away more than they can spare, then quietly goes without.

name: Quietly vain
description: Would deny it, but checks their reflection in every dark window.

name: Fatally curious
description: Has never once left the strange door unopened.

name: Loyal past reason
description: Will defend a friend long after the friend stopped deserving it.

name: Trusts slowly
description: Assumes a motive behind every kindness, and is often right.

name: Relentlessly deadpan
description: Jokes with a straight face until someone finally laughs, or doesn't.

name: Short fuse, long apology
description: Snaps fast, regrets it faster, and makes amends at length.

name: Unnervingly patient
description: Will wait years for the right moment and never mention the waiting.

name: Can't stay still
description: Taps, paces, whittles — sitting through a meeting is physically painful.

name: Painfully formal
description: Uses full titles, even mid-brawl, and finds slang faintly distressing.

name: Deflects with self-mockery
description: Beats everyone to the insult so it stings less coming from them.

name: Perfectionist
description: Would rather deliver nothing than deliver something merely adequate.

name: Allergic to planning
description: Thinks best under pressure, and arranges to be under pressure often.

name: Compulsive collector
description: Pockets buttons, teeth, and pressed flowers, each with a reason.

name: Makes lists for everything
description: Writes tasks down after completing them just to cross them off.

name: Physically can't lie well
description: Tries, fails visibly, and has learned to just stay silent instead.

name: Lies for practice
description: Invents small untruths to keep the skill sharp, then forgets which ones.

name: Adopts strays
description: Collects lost people and animals and calls it a coincidence each time.

name: Turns everything into a contest
description: Including breakfast, directions, and grief.

name: Cheerful fatalist
description: Certain it all ends badly, and in excellent spirits about it.

name: Stubbornly hopeful
description: Has been proved wrong many times and has not adjusted.

name: Carries other people's guilt
description: Apologises for weather, for other people's tempers, for existing loudly.

name: Argues with gods
description: Prays regularly, mostly to complain, and expects a reply eventually.

name: Devout in small ways
description: Keeps every minor rite perfectly and never talks about belief.

name: Squeamish about blood
description: Copes fine in the moment and falls apart an hour later.

name: Sleeps badly
description: Takes the last watch by choice, because the dreams are worse.

name: Feeds people when worried
description: Anxiety converts directly into soup and unsolicited second helpings.

name: Hoards information
description: Knows things and shares them only when the price is right.

name: Chronic oversharer
description: Tells strangers the whole story within ten minutes, every time.

name: Miserly with coin
description: Grew up hungry and still counts the copper twice.

name: Money burns holes
description: Rich for three days after every job, then broke and philosophical.

name: Compulsive teacher
description: Cannot watch anyone do a thing badly without offering a correction.

name: Reflexively defiant
description: Says no first, then works out whether they actually objected.

name: Believes in the rules
description: Not out of fear — out of a conviction that order is a kindness.

name: Gallows humour
description: Funniest at funerals, which has cost them invitations.

name: Speaks slowly and rarely
description: So people lean in, and remember what was said.

name: Terrible with names
description: Gives everyone a nickname to cover it, and the nicknames stick.

name: Flinches from touch
description: Stands just outside arm's reach and doesn't explain why.

name: Talks with their hands
description: Grabs shoulders, straightens collars, and has broken two lamps this month.

name: Deeply superstitious
description: Will not start a journey on the wrong day, whatever it costs.

name: Refuses to believe in omens
description: Loudly, and slightly too often to be convincing.

name: Keeps their word absolutely
description: Which is why they are extremely careful about giving it.

name: Flirts as a reflex
description: Means almost none of it and is genuinely surprised when it lands.

name: Never complains
description: Which makes it very hard to tell when they've been badly hurt.

name: Incurably theatrical
description: Narrates their own actions and holds a pose a beat too long.

name: Awake before everyone
description: Uses the quiet hour to think, and resents company in it.

name: Prefers animals to people
description: Talks to every horse in the stable and learns their names first.

name: Keeps a written grudge list
description: Updated in a small book, with dates, and no entries ever crossed out.

name: Polite about violence
description: Warns you properly first, and means the warning kindly.

name: Quietly homesick
description: Cooks one dish from home badly and eats it anyway.

name: Never satisfied
description: Reaches the goal, feels nothing, and immediately sets a further one.

name: Cannot let an argument stand
description: Steps between people out of instinct, sometimes into the swing.

name: Hums without noticing
description: Always the same three bars, and nobody can identify the song.

name: Carries an unopened letter
description: Sealed, addressed to them, ten years old. They haven't been ready.

name: Owes a debt to a hag
description: The favour was granted. The price hasn't been named yet.

name: Uses a dead friend's name
description: Borrowed it in a hurry years ago and has never given it back.

name: The only one who came back
description: Six went in. The town still asks. They still don't answer.

name: Exiled from a title
description: Struck from the family rolls, and still holds the signet ring.

name: Raised by their people's enemy
description: Loved them. Buried them. Has never made either fact fit the other.

name: Named in a prophecy incorrectly
description: The verse fits them almost exactly, which is somehow worse.

name: Missing a year of memory
description: Other people remember them during it. Their accounts do not agree.

name: A scar in a shape
description: It looks like a sigil. They've been careful never to show a scholar.

name: Bound by a blood oath
description: Sworn at fifteen, to someone they now suspect was lying.

name: Expelled from their guild
description: For something they did do, defending someone who didn't.

name: Wanted in a neighbouring realm
description: The poster is unflattering and the charge is roughly accurate.

name: Inherited half a map
description: Someone else has the other half and is looking for them too.

name: Their god stopped answering
description: Two years ago, mid-prayer. The spells still work, which frightens them.

name: Died once already
description: Someone paid a great deal to bring them back and hasn't asked for anything yet.

name: Their familiar disappeared
description: No death, no goodbye. They still set out a second bowl.

name: Hunted by a sibling
description: Not for revenge. To bring them home, which is worse.

name: Walked away from a war
description: Their unit was ordered to do something. They left. Some of them didn't.

name: Carries a cursed heirloom
description: It works beautifully. Everyone who has owned it has ended the same way.

name: Followed by a polite ghost
description: Only they can see it. It has never once asked for anything.

name: Their village is under water
description: A dam, a flood, a decision made elsewhere. They keep the key anyway.

name: A fey godparent
description: Attends every birthday uninvited and expects to be introduced.

name: Dreams in a language they don't know
description: They've started writing it down. A scholar went pale at the sample.

name: In debt to a thieves' guild
description: The interest is jobs, not coin, and the jobs are getting worse.

name: Their papers are forged
description: Good work, expensive, and the forger has recently been arrested.

name: Spared by a monster
description: It looked at them, chose not to, and left. They need to know why.

name: Trained by someone infamous
description: They were kind, patient, and are now the subject of a manhunt.

name: Sends money home in secret
description: To an orphanage, a widow, or a debt that isn't theirs to pay.

name: Answers to two names
description: One from before, one from after, and only one is safe in this town.

name: Counting down to something
description: They know the date. They have not told a soul what happens on it.

name: Buried something dangerous
description: They remember the place exactly and check on it once a year.

name: Fled an arranged marriage
description: Two households are still looking, and one has stopped being polite.

name: Survived a plague that took everyone
description: No scars, no reason, and neighbours who never quite forgave it.

name: Knows a royal secret
description: Overheard, not sought. It's why they left the capital in a hurry.

name: Sole survivor of a wreck
description: Washed ashore holding a crate that wasn't theirs and never opened it.

name: Credited with someone else's deed
description: The ballad is wrong. Correcting it now would ruin more than one life.

name: Made a bargain with a dragon
description: Traded something small. The dragon has been unnervingly patient since.

name: Raised in a cult they escaped
description: Still mouths the mealtime prayer without meaning to.

name: Wearing an unfamiliar body
description: It answers to their mind but has old habits they didn't teach it.

name: Writes to a dead person weekly
description: Unsent, in a bundle, and someone has recently started writing back.

name: Broke an oath and got away with it
description: No lightning, no curse. The silence has been harder than punishment.

name: Hiding a child's existence
description: Fostered under a false name, in a town they no longer visit.

name: Already spent the reward
description: The job that earned it went badly and the client is still waiting.

name: Their tattoos are a record
description: One per person they failed. They are running out of forearm.

name: Banned from an entire city
description: By name, by decree, and for reasons they describe as a misunderstanding.

name: Owes their life to an enemy
description: Who is still alive, still an enemy, and has never mentioned it.

name: Turns every gift into a negotiation
description: Can't accept a kindness without offering something back immediately, to the point of insult.

name: Finishes other people's sentences
description: Guesses where a sentence is going and says it first, wrong often enough that people now leave pauses on purpose.

name: Counts under their breath when nervous
description: Steps, stairs, breaths — anything with a number gets one, and losing count starts the fear over.

name: Sharpens something when anxious
description: A blade, a stick, a pencil — whatever's at hand gets an edge before the worry does.

name: Apologises to furniture
description: Says sorry to doorframes, chairs, and the occasional cobblestone, and means it every time.

name: Their true name is carved where they can't reach it
description: A binder etched it into stone at the bottom of a lake, or a cliff face, or a locked vault. They've never seen it written.

name: The last living witness to a broken treaty
description: Signed on as a translator decades ago. Both sides now insist the terms were different, and only they remember which.

name: Inherited a debt they never agreed to
description: Their parent's creditor found them within a week of the funeral, contract in hand and their signature already on it.

name: Never orders first
description: Waits to hear everyone else's choice before naming their own, even when they decided minutes ago.

name: Corrects their own stories mid-telling
description: Stops a good story to fix a detail nobody else would have noticed was wrong, then loses the thread entirely.

name: Picks up a few words of every language they hear
description: Can swear fluently in eleven languages and hold a real conversation in none of them.

name: Sleeps with their boots on
description: Ready to move before they're fully awake, a habit nobody has managed to talk them out of.

name: Over-thanks people for small things
description: Turns a returned dropped glove into a three-sentence speech, and means every word of it.

name: Traded their reflection for a favour
description: Mirrors show the room empty where they stand. The favour was granted; what they paid it for, they won't say.

name: Stepped into a prophecy meant for someone else
description: The verse names their sister. Their sister said no. Nobody has explained what happens when the wrong person fulfils it.

name: Recognises a stranger's face from a childhood dream
description: Has seen this exact face in the same recurring dream since they were young. They have never once said so out loud.

name: States the odds before doing anything risky
description: Announces the exact chance of failure out loud, then does the risky thing anyway, every single time.

name: Reorganises other people's belongings
description: Can't leave a cluttered shelf alone, even in someone else's house, and is baffled when this causes offence.

name: Explains jokes instead of laughing
description: Hears a joke, works out exactly why it's funny, and says so out loud before anyone else can laugh.

name: Names every object they own for more than a week
description: A sword, a cart, a particularly reliable boot — all named, all discussed as if they have opinions.

name: Talks to plants and half expects an answer
description: Narrates the weather to every windowsill herb, and swears the basil listens better than most people.

name: Officially declared dead
description: The paperwork was filed years ago, properly and irreversibly. They've never found the right office to correct it.

name: Their name was the stake in a bet they lost
description: The winner gets to pick what they're called for a year and counting. They agreed to the terms sober, which is the humiliating part.

name: Followed by a crow that only steals useful things
description: Keys, coins, the exact tool needed a day later. They've stopped calling it a coincidence and started leaving offerings.

name: Waters down their own drink and says nothing
description: Nurses the same watered ale all night so nobody notices they're not really drinking, and never explains why.

name: Always insists on carrying the map
description: Trusts their own sense of direction over anyone else's, loudly, and is wrong about one time in three.

name: Rehearses apologies before giving them
description: Works out the exact wording in advance, and it still comes out wrong at the worst possible moment.

name: Reads the ending first
description: Needs to know how it turns out before they can enjoy how it happens, in books and in plans alike.

name: Physically cannot whisper
description: Every attempt at quiet carries clean across the room, so secrets get told in written notes instead.

name: Traded their voice for one true answer
description: Speaks now only in a stranger's borrowed voice. The answer they bought was worth it. They haven't told anyone what it was.

name: Wears the boots of someone who didn't come back
description: Broken in properly now. They've stopped apologising to them out loud, but they still take the same size everywhere they go.

name: Their entire guild was dissolved overnight
description: No trial, no explanation, just a notice nailed to the door. Everyone scattered and nobody has compared notes since.

name: Introduces their job before their name
description: Says what they do before who they are, and takes a beat too long to remember the second part sometimes.

name: Won't eat food they didn't watch being made
description: Finds a reason to be in the kitchen at every stop, and has gone hungry more than once rather than make an exception.

name: Stands to greet everyone, even people they dislike
description: Manners win over feelings every time, which makes it very hard to tell who they've actually forgiven.

name: Keeps both hands visible in unfamiliar company
description: An old habit from somewhere they won't name, and the one thing that makes new allies quietly nervous instead of reassured.

name: Splits every bill to the exact copper
description: Produces a working sum before anyone else has finished eating, and once ended a friendship over four coppers.

name: Voted alone against a plan that then succeeded
description: Nobody blames them for asking, but nobody quite trusts the win either, themselves included.

name: Carries a forged copy of their own family heirloom
description: Made it themselves years ago, for a reason they no longer fully trust, and isn't always sure anymore which one they're holding.

name: Knows a door that only opens once a decade
description: The next opening is close now. They still haven't decided whether to be there, or to warn anyone else away from it.

name: Corrects grammar mid-argument
description: Cannot let a dangling modifier go unchallenged, even while being threatened with a sword.

name: Reads every document aloud before signing
description: Twice through, out loud, no matter how impatient the room gets or how simple the paper looks.

name: Always the one who tends the fire at night
description: Wakes on their own every hour to check it, and has never once asked someone else to take the watch instead.

name: Tries every strange food exactly once
description: Never twice, whatever the verdict, on principle nobody has ever gotten them to explain.

name: Sides with whoever's losing an argument
description: Merit has nothing to do with it — once someone starts losing the room, that's the side they're on.

name: Born, officially, in two different towns
description: Both registries have the date right and the place wrong for each other. Neither town has noticed yet.

name: Owns the only key to a room they've never opened
description: Inherited both together. The house has been sold twice since, always with that one door still locked in the contract.

name: Cursed to tell only the truth for one year
description: The year ended months ago. They still haven't tested whether the habit or the magic was doing the work.

name: Double-knots absolutely everything
description: Boot laces, ship's rigging, a borrowed apron — if it can be tied, it gets tied twice.

name: Pays in exact change no matter how long it takes
description: Counts out the coppers one by one while a queue forms, and has never once apologised for it.

name: Won't travel without one specific worn object
description: A ring, a tooth, a button — replaced once and never again, after the one time they forgot it.

name: Laughs at their own joke before the punchline
description: Gives it away every time, and somehow still finds it funny enough to ruin on purpose.

name: Keeps score of who apologises first
description: Never says the count aloud, but always knows it, down to the exact argument.

name: Sent the anonymous tip that started a war
description: Meant to stop one death. Only they know whose handwriting was on the letter, and the war is still going.

name: Inherited a rival they've never met
description: The feud is generations old and entirely procedural now. Neither of them remembers what started it.

name: Knows what's actually in a famous dish
description: The sign says it's a family secret. It's actually an accident nobody's had the heart to correct in thirty years.

name: Won't walk under anything unfinished
description: Scaffolding, half-built arches, ladders — all get a wide detour, whatever the weather or the hurry.

name: Finishes everyone's abandoned drink
description: Can't stand to see it wasted, and has strong opinions about which combinations should never be mixed in one stomach.

name: Always offers their left hand to shake
description: For reasons rooted in an old promise, and it has cost them exactly as many friendships as you'd expect.

name: Calls back orders like a kitchen, even off duty
description: Repeats anything asked of them in a loud, rhythmic confirmation, which unnerves people who didn't grow up in a tavern.

name: Sleeps sitting up, always has
description: Can't explain it and has stopped trying to; a bed just feels wrong flat.

name: Ghost-wrote a dead author's most famous book
description: Signed away the credit for the money at the time. The money's long gone; the royalties keep arriving under the wrong name.

name: Was raised believing they were the eldest
description: Found the birth records by accident. Has not yet decided whether telling their siblings fixes anything.

name: Knows what a beloved local holiday is actually for
description: The parade is real. The reason for it was quietly rewritten two generations ago, and only their family kept the original.

name: Insists on their full title, then asks you to skip it
description: Makes you learn all nine words of it before admitting nobody's ever actually used them.

name: Has better manners for animals than people
description: Says please to a mule and skips it entirely with the mule's owner, and sees no contradiction there.

name: Narrates their own cooking out loud
description: Talks the pot through every step like it's listening, and gets genuinely offended when a dish doesn't cooperate.

name: Never lets anyone walk them all the way home
description: Peels off a street early every time, polite about it, and has never once explained where the rest of the walk goes.

name: Constantly corrects their own posture
description: Straightens up mid-sentence, mid-meal, mid-fight, on a discipline nobody ever asked them to keep.

name: Was the model for a famous statue
description: The sculptor took liberties. People recognise the statue immediately and never once recognise them.

name: Knows which grave in the churchyard is empty
description: Paid for, maintained, visited on the right days — and there has never been anyone in it. They arranged that personally.

name: Was taught to read by someone forbidden to teach
description: The lessons were illegal on both sides of that arrangement. Only one of them was ever caught.

name: Refuses to sit for a portrait or sketch
description: Turns away from every artist in every tavern, and has never once given a reason that satisfied anybody.

name: Finishes exactly at the deadline, never early
description: Could deliver it days sooner and simply doesn't, on a private schedule nobody has ever talked them out of.

name: Named their weapon, refuses to name their mount
description: Says naming a mount is asking for grief later, and has lost three unnamed ones anyway.

name: Always walks on the outside, nearer the traffic
description: Switches sides without a word whenever the street does, an old courtesy nobody's asked for in years.

name: Repeats a stranger's last few words as a question
description: A trick for buying thinking time that everyone notices and nobody has mentioned to their face.

name: Owns a deed to land that's now underwater
description: Bought it as an investment, dry, thirty years ago. Still pays the tax, on principle, to a crown that finds this hilarious.

name: Was briefly, legally married to a ghost
description: Settled an inheritance dispute and nothing else. The paperwork was real. Explaining it at parties has never once gone well.

name: Knows the words that end a curse, not who's under it
description: Learned the counter-charm from a dying stranger who never said the target's name. They've been listening ever since.

name: Tips before the service, never after
description: Says it gets better work out of people, and has never once tested whether that's actually true.

name: Checks every mirror is actually a mirror
description: Taps the glass, watches the delay, and has never explained what convinced them not to trust one on sight.

name: Remembers people by scent, not face
description: Recognises an old friend by their soap before their face registers, and finds portraits nearly useless.

name: Keeps a moment of silence before every meal, even alone
description: Nobody taught them this. They started it themselves and have never skipped it, not even mid-argument.

name: Always leaves before the performance ends
description: Missed every ending in living memory on principle, and has strong theories about most of them anyway.

name: Caused the incident a famous law is named after
description: The statute doesn't use their name. Everyone in the profession still calls it by the story instead.

name: Carries a banned book entirely in memory
description: The last written copy burned years ago. They've never once written it back down, and haven't said why.

name: Was paid to forget something that keeps coming back
description: The spell was supposed to be permanent. Fragments surface anyway, usually at the worst possible moment, and they've stopped telling anyone which ones.

name: Insists on lighting every candle in the room personally
description: Won't let anyone else near the tinderbox, and has never given a reason beyond 'I've got it.'

name: Corrects the time on every clock they pass
description: Carries their own accurate time and silently judges every public clock that disagrees with it.

name: Brings their own chair to other people's gatherings
description: Claims every other chair in the world is built wrong, and has never once been talked out of hauling theirs along.

name: Won't call a task finished until they say so out loud
description: The work can be complete for an hour before they finally announce it, usually to an empty room.

name: Says goodbye to a room, not just the people in it
description: A quiet word to the doorway or the hearth on the way out, and has never once explained who it's really for.

name: Born during the one total eclipse anyone alive remembers
description: The town still marks the date without quite saying why, and has never once asked how they feel about that.

name: Promised the same locked box's contents to three different people
description: None of them know about the other two. The box has been closed longer than any of the promises have existed.

name: Received a letter exactly one year late, from someone since dead
description: The post office has no explanation. The letter reads like it was written yesterday, about things that haven't happened yet.

name: Never signs their name the same way twice
description: Claims it's a security measure. Every clerk who's tried to verify it has eventually given up and started trusting the wax seal instead.

name: Walks around every puddle, however small
description: Boots built for worse haven't changed the habit, and neither has anyone's teasing about it.

name: Won't let a conversation end on a question
description: Will add one more sentence just to make sure the last word was a statement, even a bad one.

name: Won't wear a colour until they've seen someone else wear it first
description: Insists this is caution, not vanity, and has never once explained the difference convincingly.

name: Always asks who made a thing before buying it
description: Won't complete a purchase without a name attached, and remembers every one, good and bad, for years.

name: Was legally adopted by a guild, not a family
description: The paperwork lists the guildhall as next of kin. It has never once been challenged in court, which worries them more than reassures them.

name: Knows a dead king's actual last words
description: The official record says something noble. What was actually said was shorter, ruder, and only they were close enough to hear it.

name: Carries a key to a door that was torn down years ago
description: Kept it anyway. Won't say whether that's sentiment or a habit of hoping the wall gets rebuilt exactly right.

name: Tastes everything twice
description: Tastes a dish hot and then again once it's cooled, and considers a recipe that only works hot to be unfinished.

name: Repays debts before nightfall
description: Settles even a trivial debt before the sun goes down, whatever the inconvenience, and treats an unpaid one at dusk as bad luck.

name: Treats old insults as inside jokes
description: Repeats old insults back affectionately, which confuses the people who meant them seriously at the time.

name: Treats silence as an answer
description: Reads a long pause as a real answer and acts on it immediately, which is sometimes right and often expensive.

name: Leaves one button deliberately wrong
description: Leaves one button undone or mismatched on every outfit, on purpose, for reasons they've never fully explained to anyone.

name: Borrowed a stranger's luck for a day
description: Traded for a stranger's good luck years ago in a deal neither of them understood, and the stranger has been collecting the difference since.

name: Their face is in a painting older than they are
description: Appears, unexplained, in the background of a portrait finished before they were born. Nobody has identified the painter yet.

name: Quietly retried for a crime they were already cleared of
description: Acquitted years ago. The same court reopened the case last year under a new judge's name, and nobody has told them so directly.

name: Deflects compliments with unrelated facts
description: Answers any compliment with an unrelated fact, as though changing the subject were the same thing as saying thank you.

name: Marks every room they've slept in twice
description: Leaves a small pencil mark on the wall of any room they've stayed in more than once, and is quietly running out of walls.

name: Picks up a stranger's accent mid-conversation
description: Slips into a stranger's accent within minutes without meaning to, and has caused real offence being mistaken for mockery.

name: Won't fight with a blade that isn't theirs
description: Refuses a borrowed weapon even in an emergency, and has taken a hit rather than break the rule.

name: Never takes the head of the table
description: Turns down the head-of-table seat wherever they eat, even offered as an honour, and won't explain why the geometry matters.

name: Heir to a throne that no longer has a country
description: A distant claim to a throne whose kingdom stopped existing generations ago, kept alive by one extremely persistent aunt.

name: Told the exact, mundane details of their own death
description: A fortune-teller once described it precisely. Every detail so far has come true except, obviously, the last one.

name: A town two valleys over is named for a lie they told
description: Invented a heroic act on the spot to end an old argument. The town built a statue. Nobody there knows the truth but them.

name: Arrives absurdly early to everything
description: Treats being on time as basically late, and has strong opinions about anyone who doesn't.

name: Remembers every compliment word for word
description: Can recite any compliment ever paid to them verbatim, under only mild duress.

name: Won't answer to any nickname
description: Simply doesn't respond until the full name is used, however affectionately the short one was meant.

name: Can't leave a tangle alone
description: Knots, tangled hair, tangled string — all get untangled on sight, and it has made them late to genuinely urgent things.

name: Always saves an empty seat at the table
description: Sets one extra place or leaves one chair free at every meal, and has never once said who it's for.

name: Two graves carry their exact name
description: One in each of two countries, neither one theirs, and they've visited neither to find out why.

name: Sold a cursed object that keeps coming back
description: Got rid of it years ago. It keeps finding its way to their doorstep, wrapped a little differently each time.

name: Present at the first casting of a now-famous spell
description: Watched it work the very first time, in a cramped room nobody remembers correctly, and has never once been asked about it.

name: Collects recipes and never cooks them
description: Writes down every recipe anyone describes to them in careful detail, and has never once actually cooked a single one.

name: Keeps a private tally of everyone's luck
description: Silently rates how lucky or unlucky the people around them seem to be, and adjusts plans around the unlucky ones without saying why.

name: Answers almost everything with another question
description: Has been accused, fairly, of never once giving a straight answer in living memory.

name: Won't sit down during a thunderstorm
description: Stays on their feet indoors or out for the whole storm, on an old family rule they've never once explained.

name: Exits every room backward
description: Leaves any room facing it rather than the hallway, a habit picked up somewhere they won't discuss.

name: Owns a famous painter's last, unfinished work
description: The painter died mid-brushstroke. They've never once let anyone else see how it ends in their own head.

name: Brought someone back from the edge of death, once
description: By means they've never repeated and won't explain, not even to the person it saved.

name: A whole town forgot the crime they actually committed
description: Everyone there remembers that week differently now, cleanly, except them — they remember all of it.

name: Always carries a spare of anything important
description: A spare key, coin, blade, bootlace — and has never once needed the spare for the thing it was meant for.

name: Quietly finishes other people's unfinished chores
description: Can't watch an unfinished task sit, and finishes it for someone else without being asked or thanked.

name: Remembers birthdays, forgets names
description: Knows everyone's birthday down to the year, and loses their name again within the hour.

name: Apologises before doing anything that might annoy someone
description: Says sorry in advance whether or not the thing actually turns out to be annoying.

name: Holds eye contact a beat too long, except when lying
description: Stares straight through any serious conversation, and looks away first only on the one topic they're not being honest about.

name: Drew the definitive map of a region they've never visited
description: Everyone still uses it. It was assembled entirely from secondhand stories, and they've never once corrected the parts they know are wrong.

name: Knows the unspoken next verse of a 'finished' prophecy
description: Everyone else considers the prophecy complete. They haven't decided whether reciting the rest helps anything or ends it.

name: Quietly paid off the bounty on their own head
description: Tracked it down years ago under a different name and settled it. It's never been reissued, or explained to anyone.

name: Sings under their breath specifically during danger
description: Picks up a work-song exactly when things turn dangerous, and has been told more than once how unsettling the timing is.

name: Can't sleep without some light burning
description: However small the flame or lamp, it has to stay lit, and they've never explained why to anyone who's asked.

name: Never fully unpacks anywhere
description: Keeps one bag permanently ready by the door, even after months in the same room.

name: Quietly re-measures anything someone else already measured
description: Won't trust a measurement until they've checked it themselves, discreetly, before anyone notices.

name: Can't tolerate a lull in conversation
description: Will ask almost anything, however personal, just to keep a silence from settling in.

name: Carries the last viable seed of a crop that failed everywhere else
description: Hasn't decided yet whether planting it or keeping it safe is the bigger risk to take.

name: Two families both claim them as their long-lost child
description: Both stories almost fit. They've let both families believe it a little too long to correct either one now.

name: Sent the anonymous warning that saved a stranger's life
description: The stranger has spent years trying to find out who to thank. They've never once come close.

name: Tells the same three jokes on a loop
description: Cycles through the same three jokes with any new audience, and is delighted every time someone hasn't heard them yet.

name: Treats an unusually pleasant day as a warning
description: Spends any suspiciously nice day bracing for what it's covering for, instead of enjoying it.

name: Keeps every promise to the exact letter, never the spirit
description: Has caused real damage this way, in perfectly good faith, more than once.

name: Unconsciously copies the posture of whoever they're negotiating with
description: Has been caught at it by the sharper negotiators, who now shift position on purpose to test them.

name: Always delivers the worst part of any news last
description: Builds as long a preamble as it takes to get there, however patient the listener has to be.

name: Built a door in their own home that opens onto a wall
description: Did it on purpose, years ago, and still checks every night that it's locked.

name: Knows the only surviving verse of a song a whole village used to sing
description: Hums it wrong on purpose in public, so nobody can steal it accurately from listening.

name: Someone who owed them their life died still owing it
description: They've never worked out who, if anyone, inherits a debt like that.

name: Sends a written thank-you note after being insulted
description: Always polite, always prompt, and has never once explained whether it's sincere or a warning.

name: Presses down on any chair before trusting it with their weight
description: Does it in houses they've visited a hundred times, out of a caution nobody's ever managed to talk them out of.

name: Writes down the last thing said to them before any goodbye
description: Just in case it turns out to matter later, which it occasionally has.

name: Silently rearranges cutlery to the correct setting at any table
description: Whatever the host's own arrangement was, and has never once been asked to stop by anyone who noticed.

name: Guesses a stranger's trade from their hands before asking their name
description: Says the guess out loud immediately, right or wrong, and keeps a private tally of how often it lands.

name: Was raised speaking a language only one grandparent still remembered
description: Hasn't met another living speaker of it since, and has started to forget which words they might be inventing by now.

name: Signed a binding contract in a script they can't read
description: Did it on the advice of someone they trusted completely, who they haven't seen since the ink dried.

name: Raised what they thought was an unusual dog from a pup
description: It stopped growing at exactly the wrong size to still plausibly be one.

name: Taps any surface in groups of exactly three
description: Does it while thinking, and loses the thread completely if interrupted mid-tap.

name: Will never be the one to suggest turning back
description: Even on a journey they privately think should end, and has walked into worse than a few turned-back trips would have avoided.

name: Won't break in new boots without someone else present
description: On the theory that first steps in anything, boots included, matter more than people give them credit for.

name: Always gives gifts in odd numbers, never even
description: Has strong unspoken opinions about anyone who doesn't bother with the distinction.

name: Gently corrects anyone who mispronounces their own name
description: Does it to strangers as readily as friends, entirely out of principle, and always just as gently.

name: Owns the real version of a masterpiece everyone assumes is a forgery
description: The art world settled on 'fake' generations ago. They've never once corrected the record.

name: Personally trained the rival who's since surpassed and disowned them
description: Has never told a soul the training ever happened, and doesn't expect the favour to be returned.

name: Knows where someone everyone else believes is dead is actually living
description: Keeps the secret at that person's own request, and has never once been tempted to explain why.

name: Always sits facing the room's only door
description: Manoeuvres for the seat with a clear line to the exit in any room, and is visibly unsettled the rare times it isn't available.

name: Smells every coin before pocketing it
description: A leftover trick from a life that once depended on telling a counterfeit by scent alone, still done automatically today.

name: Always claims the heaviest pack without discussion
description: Takes the worst-loaded bag before anyone can offer, every single trip, and has never once explained why it matters to them.

name: Turns their back only on people they've fully decided to trust
description: A private test nobody's told about; the few who've noticed being trusted this way rarely forget it.

name: Always pushes a locked door rather than pulling
description: Tests every door the same way first, out of a caution nobody has ever managed to talk them out of.

name: Made a promise to a stranger who died before giving a name
description: Swore to finish what a dying stranger couldn't, sealed in a handshake at the very end. There was never a name left to know if it's done.

name: The only living person a famous hermit ever spoke to
description: Visited a famous hermit once a year for a decade before they vanished for good, and has never once repeated a word of what was said.

name: Owns land that measures differently on every map ever drawn of it
description: Every surveyor swears to a different acreage under oath, and the tax office has simply stopped asking anyone to check again.

name: Never cuts through a graveyard, whatever the detour
description: Will add twenty minutes to any route rather than cut through a graveyard, and has never once explained the extra time to anyone waiting.

name: Always breaks bread before offering it
description: Never offers bread whole, always breaks it first with their own hands, a small hospitality rule they can't explain and won't skip.

name: Won't let anyone else near their inkwell
description: Insists on mixing and refilling their own ink personally, and has strong opinions about anyone who waters it down to stretch it.

name: Refuses to step directly on a threshold
description: Steps cleanly over every threshold rather than on it, and has never explained which old warning that habit came from.

name: Gives every place they stay a private nickname
description: Renames every town or inn within a day of arriving, and slips and uses it in front of locals more often than they'd like.

name: The last apprentice of a school that no longer exists
description: Trained under a master whose entire school was shut down for reasons never made public, and is the only one still practising what it taught.

name: Knows the true reason a famous bridge collapsed
description: Was there the night a famous bridge collapsed, and knows it wasn't the storm everyone still blames it on.

name: Owes a favour to their own future self
description: Agreed to a favour with a seer who claimed to speak for their own future self. They still don't know what was promised, or when it's due.

name: Says a quiet word over any new tool before first use
description: Blesses a new tool under their breath before its first use, whether or not they'd call themselves religious about anything else.

name: Always shakes hands twice, arriving and leaving
description: Considers one handshake an introduction and the other a promise, and has never explained the difference to anyone who asked.

name: Removes their hat indoors, whatever the weather outside
description: Bare-headed the moment they cross any threshold, even into a flooding house, on a manners rule nobody taught them to keep.

name: Never accepts the first price offered, even a fair one
description: Haggles on principle rather than need, and has occasionally talked a price up by mistake before noticing.

name: Refuses to whistle indoors, under any circumstances
description: Won't whistle indoors for any reason, out of an old superstition they can explain in full but have never once tested.

name: Married by proxy to a spouse they've never met
description: Married by proxy years ago to seal an alliance between houses, to a spouse they've still never actually met in person.

name: Won a formal duel by a rule technicality
description: Won a formal duel by invoking a rule so obscure the judges had to look it up twice, and nobody's successfully used it since.

name: Their childhood home is now a shrine to an unknown saint
description: Their childhood home was converted into a shrine to a saint they've never once heard of anywhere else, for reasons the town won't explain.

name: Always leaves one small gap in any wall or fence they build
description: Leaves a single deliberate gap in every wall or fence they build, on a private rule about not boxing anything in completely.

name: Never eats the last bite of any meal
description: Leaves exactly one bite on the plate at every meal, out of a superstition they've never once bothered to explain.

name: Corrects anyone who calls their success luck
description: Interrupts immediately to correct 'lucky' to 'earned,' every single time, however small the success being credited.

name: Repays a debt of gratitude within a day, ignores debts of coin
description: Treats an unspoken thank-you as urgent business to settle within a day, and shows no such urgency at all about money owed.

name: Never tastes their own cooking, only ever asks someone else to
description: Refuses to taste-test a dish they've made themselves, and has built an entire kitchen routine around asking someone else to.

name: Legally declared a protected monument
description: Petitioned, decades ago as a joke, to be declared a protected monument. It passed. Leaving the country now technically requires a permit.

name: Impersonated a foreign dignitary for an entire state visit
description: Impersonated a foreign dignitary for the length of an entire state visit as a young favour to a desperate friend, and was never once caught.

name: Their exact birth weight is cast into a distant temple bell
description: Their exact birth weight was cast into a temple bell in a city they've never once visited, for a family reason nobody explained to them.

name: Shakes out their boots every morning before putting them on
description: Checks and shakes out both boots every single morning without fail, in any climate, on a habit nobody's ever managed to explain away.

name: Repeats a new acquaintance's name three times early in conversation
description: Says a new acquaintance's name three separate times within the first few minutes of meeting, and swears this is simply how names stick.

name: Always eats with cutlery in the opposite hand from everyone else present
description: Holds the fork or knife in whichever hand nobody else at the table is using, and has never once given a reason that satisfied anybody.

name: Always gives away the last coin in their purse to a stranger
description: Empties whatever coin is left in their purse to the nearest stranger before returning home, and has done it enough times to worry their friends.

name: Stands impeccably straight only when being watched
description: Stands impeccably straight the moment they notice being watched, and slouches completely the instant they think nobody is.

name: Their family crest was redesigned to hide a shameful detail
description: Their family crest was quietly redesigned two generations back to hide one detail nobody in the family has ever agreed to name out loud.

name: Once talked a mob down from a hanging using only a story
description: Once talked an entire mob down from a hanging using nothing but a story, and has never once told the same version of it twice since.

name: Spent one winter as a lost child somewhere in the wild
description: Spent one winter as a small child somewhere in the wild before being found; remembers only the cold clearly, never once the wolves everyone assumes were there.

name: Refuses to sign anything with a quill they didn't cut themselves
description: Carries their own knife just to cut a fresh quill before signing anything important, and distrusts every pre-cut one offered to them.

name: Always finishes a sentence even after being interrupted for minutes
description: Picks up a sentence exactly where it was interrupted, however many minutes later, and expects the room to remember where that was too.

name: Introduces pets by their full given names, never nicknames
description: Gives every pet a full formal name at acquisition and uses only that name in public, however long or ridiculous it turns out to be.

name: Walks around a spilled drink for days after it's dried
description: Steps around the spot of a spilled drink for as long as the stain lasts, dried or not, and has never once explained the exact rule.

name: Refuses to let anyone else count their money
description: Recounts any money handed to them personally before accepting it, and has never once let a friend do the counting instead.

name: Once won an entire dukedom at cards and gave it back
description: Once won an entire dukedom at cards in a single legendary hand, and quietly gave the title back within the week for reasons never explained.

name: An entire village adopted them after a shipwreck
description: Washed ashore as the only survivor of a wreck as an infant, and an entire village signed the adoption papers together rather than choose just one family.

name: Knows a famous general's private nickname
description: Knows the private nickname a now-famous general answered to only with one now-dead friend, and has never once let it slip in public.

name: Always tucks a napkin into their collar, even eating alone
description: Tucks a napkin into their collar before any meal, even eating alone standing at a counter, and has never once explained the habit to anyone who's asked.

name: Removes their boots before entering any tent, even in the rain
description: Won't step into a tent with boots still on, their own included, whatever the weather is doing outside it.

name: Silently says a dish's full correct name before eating it
description: Says the full, correct name of whatever's on the plate under their breath before the first bite, and has never once skipped it, not even hungry.

name: Closes every gate or door they pass through, even ones they didn't open
description: Closes every gate or door they pass, opened by them or not, and has walked back a considerable distance more than once to do it.

name: Keeps every broken tool instead of discarding it
description: Keeps every broken tool rather than throwing it out, certain each one will be useful again someday, and has run out of room twice already.

name: Was legally married to their own reflection to break a curse
description: Was legally married to their own reflection years ago to break a mirror-curse, and the paperwork undoing it was somehow never properly filed.

name: Knows why a famous duel really ended in a draw
description: Was the only witness close enough to see why a famous duel ended in a draw rather than a death, and has never once corrected the popular version.

name: Owns the boots of a rival who retired undefeated
description: Owns the boots of a rival who retired undefeated and simply handed them over one day, with no explanation offered or ever asked for.

name: Argues with every book in the margins
description: Can't read anything without writing a rebuttal in the margin, and has been banned from three separate libraries for exactly this.

name: Silently counts any staircase they haven't yet memorised
description: Counts every step under their breath the first several times up any new staircase, and stops mid-sentence if the count ever comes out wrong.

name: Refuses to finish telling a story while hungry
description: Will stop mid-sentence, however good the story, to eat first, and picks it back up afterward as if no time passed at all.

name: Refills anyone's cup the moment it's below half
description: Tops up a neighbour's drink at any table in any country, host or not, and has never once managed to sit through a full meal without doing it.

name: Talks through what their hands are doing when nervous
description: Narrates their own hands out loud under stress — threading a needle, loading a crossbow — whether or not anyone's actually listening.

name: Inherited a map that stops exactly where a parent vanished
description: The map was left half-drawn by a parent who never came back from that expedition, and the blank edge lines up exactly with where they were headed.

name: Carries a key that has fit no lock for three generations
description: Passed down through the family for three generations without ever once finding its lock, and nobody's been allowed to melt it down and check.

name: Gave the testimony that convicted their own mentor
description: Testified under oath against the person who trained them, and still isn't entirely sure, years later, that the crime was actually committed.

name: Repeats any direction back word for word before setting off
description: Says any direction given to them back out loud immediately, and gets visibly uneasy if nobody confirms it was right.

name: Sorts every coin by minting year before spending any
description: Won't spend a coin out of order once it's been sorted, and always lets the oldest one go first, whatever the cost in time.

name: Smells a sealed letter before breaking it open
description: Claims the wax alone can tell good news from bad, and has been right often enough that nobody teases them about it anymore.

name: Refuses to deliver good news after dark
description: Holds any good news back until sunrise however urgent it feels, and makes everyone wait the whole night to hear it properly.

name: Always circles a new campsite once before setting up
description: Walks a counterclockwise loop around any new campsite before unpacking a single bag, and has never agreed to skip it or explain why.

name: Sold their own shadow at a joke auction, for real money
description: A bidder actually paid for it. Nobody present will say whether anything about them has been different since.

name: Finished a major commission for a client who never came back
description: The piece has sat wrapped and ready for years, in case the client who vanished before collecting it ever does.

name: A distant town elected them mayor while they were nowhere near it
description: No election has been held there since. The town is apparently still waiting for them to show up and accept.

name: Knocks exactly twice on any door, however urgent
description: Has been seen knocking twice on a burning building before trying the handle, and shows no sign of ever changing the habit.

name: Never returns a borrowed tool in the same condition it arrived
description: Sharpens, oils, or mends anything lent to them before giving it back, quietly, and has never once mentioned doing it.

name: Reads a room's whole mood from the doorway before stepping in
description: Pauses at any threshold to take the temperature of a room first, and has walked back out again, without a word, more than once.

name: Walks the full perimeter of any new building before going inside
description: Does it in any weather, before so much as a greeting, and has never once explained what exactly they're checking for.

name: Writes their name in tiny letters inside everything they own
description: Marks even borrowed gear returned a hundred times before, just in case, in handwriting almost too small to read.

name: Wrote their own eulogy and gave it to a stranger to deliver
description: Sealed it with instructions never to open it early, then became genuine friends with that stranger without ever once bringing it up again.

name: Paid for a secret's silence that got out anyway
description: The secret surfaced years later from somewhere else entirely. They've never learned whether the silence they paid for held, or was simply beaten to it.

name: A town pays them, formally, never to sing in public again
description: The contract is old, written, and technically still binds their grandchildren too — nobody will explain what the singing actually did.

name: Touches the nearest wood after saying anything boastful
description: Taps whatever's nearest the instant a boast leaves their mouth, and has been caught patting a stranger's walking cane for lack of a table.

name: Always arranges to sleep facing the room's window or opening
description: Takes the worse bed if that's what it costs, and has never once explained what exactly they expect to see coming.

name: Echoes back the exact greeting given to them, word for word
description: Finds any other reply oddly dishonest, and has confused more than one stranger by repeating their own words straight back at them.

name: Picks up whatever song is being sung locally within a day of arriving
description: Hums it constantly whether or not they know the words, and never once notices doing it until someone else points it out.

name: Keeps every gift's wrapping and gives the gift itself away
description: Has a whole trunk of saved ribbon and paper to show for it, and has never once given a straight answer about where the actual gifts went.

name: Kept a famous device's true original and sold the client a duplicate
description: Delivered a near-perfect duplicate as the real thing and quietly kept the true original for themselves, to a client who's never once suspected.

name: Placed two younger siblings with different families after a tragedy
description: Gave each a different surname for safety and has quietly checked on both for years, without ever once introducing them to each other.

name: Anonymously paid for a complete stranger's funeral
description: Read the obituary and felt, for reasons they still can't articulate, that they owed that person something. They never learned the full story.

name: Greets every cat they pass with a name they just invented
description: Says it with total confidence, as though it's definitely the cat's real name, and has never once been proven wrong to their satisfaction.

name: Ends every story with a moral that doesn't quite fit it
description: Tacks on a lesson whether or not the story actually taught one, and delivers it with the same confidence either way.

name: Leaves one tiny private mark on every piece of finished work
description: Somewhere unseen, on everything they make, and has never once told anyone what it means or where exactly to find it.

name: Takes the exact same route home every single night
description: Whatever the weather or the shortcut offered, and has never given a reason beyond 'it's the route.'

name: Writes a postscript longer than the letter it's attached to
description: Insists every time that the real message was always in the postscript, and the letter itself was just the formality.

name: Arranged, decades ago, for one stranger to cross a bridge toll-free for life
description: Set it up privately and has never once told that stranger why, even though they've crossed for free more times than either of them has counted.

name: Inherited a hundred-year lease on a building torn down before they were born
description: The landlord's estate still insists the rent is owed on the empty lot, and nobody on either side has ever actually gone to look at it.

name: Owns what everyone assumes is the last surviving copy of a book
description: It's actually the second-to-last. The true last copy's owner asked them, once, never to correct the record, and they never have.

name: Claps deliberately off the beat for performances they actually loved
description: Claps in perfect time for the merely competent, and off the beat on purpose for the ones that genuinely moved them, and has never once explained the difference.

name: Refuses to learn a practical skill from a manual alone
description: Insists on watching someone actually do it first, however clear the instructions look on the page, and won't be talked out of the principle.

name: Deliberately leaves one small task unfinished at day's end
description: Does it on purpose, every single day, as a private reason to get up again the next morning.

name: Mutters a weather forecast to themselves every morning
description: Does it before anyone else is awake to hear it, and keeps a quietly proud private tally of how often they turn out right.

name: Strings the first coin ever earned from each new trade onto one cord
description: Drills a hole through it and adds it to the same cord every time, which has gotten uncomfortably heavy over the years.

name: Secretly helped raise a bitter rival's child after the rival disappeared
description: Did it under a cover story that neither the child nor the rival's remaining family has ever once questioned.

name: Won a public debate so decisively it got written into law within the year
description: Hasn't attended a single debate since, and has never once said whether the law turned out to be a good idea.

name: Has spent years keeping a promise the other person forgot they ever asked for
description: Hasn't decided whether a promise like that is still owed, and has quietly kept it anyway rather than find out.

name: Answers any question they don't want to answer by stating the time instead
description: Says it with total sincerity, as though the hour were genuinely the information requested.

name: Translates an unfamiliar insult back aloud, word for word
description: The literal translation usually kills the insult's sting entirely, which the insulter rarely anticipates.

name: Keeps a whole second set of worn, mediocre tools purely to lend out
description: So the good ones never once have to leave the house, whatever the borrower's story.

name: Stops mid-sentence to correct their own grammar out loud
description: Then carries on exactly where they left off, whoever's listening and however urgent the conversation.

name: Files every favour done for them away like a debt with interest
description: And calls it in, years later, with an uncomfortable precision nobody saw coming.

name: Raised the alarm before a disaster everyone else dismissed
description: Was the only one who sounded it in time, and still isn't sure whether being right made the aftermath better or worse.

name: Inherited a generations-old family rivalry with no rival left to carry it
description: Learned only recently that the rival family quietly died out decades ago, and still isn't sure who they're supposed to be angry at now.

name: Secretly mistranslated one clause of a treaty they were hired to render faithfully
description: The resulting peace has held for years anyway, which they've decided not to examine too closely.

name: Reopens a deal the moment any new detail turns up
description: Considers a bargain binding only until new information arrives, however small, and is genuinely baffled when this gets called bad faith.

name: Never states a price directly
description: Explains any price as a short story about what it cost them instead, and expects the listener to do the subtraction themselves.

name: Never cries at bad news, only good
description: Stayed dry-eyed through every funeral they've attended, and cried for a solid hour the day a failing crop finally came in.

name: Keeps a private, more accurate version of any story they've simplified
description: Updates the private account quietly for years rather than ever correcting the comfortable public one out loud.

name: Finishes one small, ordinary task immediately after getting hurt
description: Refuses to let an injury be the last thing anyone sees them do, however minor the task or serious the wound.

name: Drafted an obscure clause into a trade law purely to protect one stranger
description: Met that stranger exactly once, years ago, and the stranger has never once found out what was quietly done for them.

name: Funded a second bridge beside one that worked perfectly fine
description: Has never once explained what exactly was wrong with the first bridge, which still stands, unused, right beside the new one.

name: Knows the real, far less flattering reason a centuries-old feast was moved to a different week
description: The official story is tradition. The real one, two generations back, is considerably less dignified.

name: Refuses to discuss any business until the meal in front of them is finished
description: Good news or bad, however urgent, waits politely until the plate is clean.

name: Describes the weather happening to them as though reporting on a stranger
description: Says things like 'and now the rain finds her' mid-downpour, and has never once broken character to explain why.

name: Verbally agrees with any instruction immediately, then quietly ignores it
description: Does exactly what they'd already planned regardless of what was agreed to, every single time, without ever raising their voice.

name: Formally tips their hat to every crow they pass
description: Does it out of a respect they've never once bothered explaining to anyone who's asked.

name: Carries two knives, one sharp and one deliberately blunt
description: Hands over only the blunt one whenever a stranger asks to borrow a blade, and has never once offered an explanation.

name: Privately wrote the missing final chapter to a beloved unfinished saga
description: Wrote it after the original author died, and has let exactly one other person read it so far.

name: Spent a year secretly raising funds for a war that ended before the money was needed
description: Never found a graceful way to explain the leftover coin, so it's still sitting, untouched, in a sealed account.

name: Sat on the jury of a famous trial that almost went the other way
description: Knows the real verdict hinged on a single vote nobody official ever recorded, and has never once said whose.

name: Answers questions meant for whoever just stepped away
description: Confidently supplies an answer on someone else's behalf rather than make the asker wait, and is wrong often enough to matter.

name: Insists on sitting down before continuing any argument past its first exchange
description: Will physically pull up a chair mid-shouting-match, and has ended more fights than it's started.

name: Reads any sign or label faster upside down than right-side up
description: A habit left over from a childhood spent across a counter from everyone else, and useless exactly once a year.

name: Keeps a private daily weather log for a town they haven't lived in for years
description: Mails it nowhere and shows it to no one, and has never once missed a single day's entry.

name: Returns, however far they've travelled, to personally put out any fire they lit
description: Refuses to trust even a dying fire to burn itself out unwatched, whatever the detour costs them.

name: Signed a peace treaty between two villages no one can prove were ever at war
description: The treaty is real, dated, and witnessed. No record of the war it ended has ever turned up anywhere else.

name: Holds a tie-breaking vote in a centuries-old council dispute
description: The vote has never once needed using, by a rule nobody still living can explain the origin of.

name: Knows the real reason the town well ran dry for a month and refilled overnight
description: Has let the official 'drought' explanation stand for years rather than say what they actually saw happen at the bottom of it.

name: Keeps a whole shelf of unlabeled jars
description: Insists aloud that they still remember exactly what's in every single one, and has been wrong at dinner more than once.

name: Narrates other people's choices out loud as they make them
description: Does it like a sports commentator, uninvited, and has been asked to stop more times than it's actually worked.

name: Won't sit anywhere a shadow is actively moving across them
description: Will relocate mid-meal rather than stay put, and has never once explained what exactly the moving matters.

name: Can't end an apology without landing one small joke right after it
description: Does it however serious the apology was, which has undercut more than one that genuinely needed to land.

name: Privately counts every disaster that almost happened but didn't
description: Treats the running total as meaningful, and has never once shared the actual number with anyone.

name: Owns the legal deed to a street that quietly renamed itself two generations ago
description: The paperwork still uses the old name, and nobody at the records office has ever agreed to update it.

name: Was the lone recorded objection in an otherwise unanimous historic vote
description: Has never once said why, even decades later, to historians who've asked them directly.

name: Knows which of two identical twins actually survived a childhood accident
description: The town believes only one lived. Has never once corrected which name ended up on which grave.
